'''Arachnotrons''' appear in ''[[Doom 64]]''.

==Background==
The Arachnotrons of ''Doom 64'' are resurrected by the [[Mother Demon]]. This left them considerably altered; the mechanical body is much bigger, with the brain head ducked down inside the machine itself instead of sitting atop it, also not having any organic arms like the classic version, and the mechanical legs (now six instead of only four) bulkier and more spiderlike. Instead of a single plasma gun, the ''Doom 64'' Arachnotrons possess two guns: these fire together in bursts of five rounds from each gun rather than continuously.

The Doom 64 Arachnotrons are masters of ranged combat; many times they are placed in sniping, out of reach positions, able to hit the player from afar with ease. They are also seldom alone, usually placed with other monsters of doubled up with more of their kind, upping their threat considerably.

That said, they can still be taken down as they could before; large scale weapons like the rocket launcher and plasma gun will kill them quickly, yet they seem to be particularly weak to the Unmaker. If the player powers it up with at least two Demon Keys, it will fell an Arachnotron in mere seconds.

==Info==
They first appear in [[MAP13: Dark Citadel (Doom 64)|MAP13: Dark Citadel]] unless the player goes through [[MAP30: The Lair (Doom 64)|MAP30: The Lair]] and [[MAP32: Hectic (Doom 64)|MAP32: Hectic]], which contain Arachnotrons but chronologically come first.
